_comment: 8b R3 (issue #11) 'The Price of a Favor' TALK path -- NO combat anywhere. Loads riverfarm_talk_start ([Diplomat] L1, 11,10 facing up beside the headman). Full loop: GIVE (headman banks heard_price_of_a_favor + starts price_of_a_favor) -> cross to the witch's hollow and MEDIATE (the [Diplomat]-gated chain: hub -> mediate_pitch -> mediate_argue, banking blight_lifted + mediated_the_debt + persuaded_someone -- the renegotiated year of hearth-tending) -> REPORT to the headman (price_of_a_favor_reported -> quest_completed). PLUS the shared post-conditions every path converges on: the village visual_states BRIGHTEN (asserted via the raw counter; the visual read itself is the windowed pass's job), the charmed villager's echo RETIRES (talk_pool_stages swap, no more echo_of), and the witch-cottage VENDOR unlocks (a real 4g buy). Screenshots bracket the brighten payoff (before/after, same cell+facing) plus the vendor surface. Issue #65's own end-to-end proof rides the tail: BEFORE any purchase, riverfarm_anchor_stone's portal menu (door_awakened/riverfarm_attuned both pre-banked in the fixture) excludes Invrisil -- an exact dialogue_node.options array match, not just the internal accomplishment counter. The vendor visit then buys BOTH the yarrow bundle (4g) and the new Invrisil attunement stone (18g, composing {gold},{item},{accomplishment} on one option -- the resonant_catalyst/bought_catalyst precedent), banking invrisil_attuned. The double-buy NEGATIVE rides the same visit: re-entering the shop after the sale pins the exact options array WITHOUT the stone row (hide_when invrisil_attuned -- the retire proof). AFTER, the SAME anchor stone's menu now includes Invrisil -- proving the letter-to-Eloise re-route live, not merely via a pre-banked fixture (that's near_invrisil's own job, invrisil_walkthrough).
